verses.translation: For the end, concerning the people that were removed from the sanctuary, by David for a memorial, when the Philistines caught him in Geth.

translations.ron: Mântuieşte-mă, Doamne, că m-a necăjit omul; toată ziua războindu-se m-a necăjit.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων μεμακρυμμένου, τῷ Δαυὶδ εἰς στηλογραφίαν, ὁπότε ἐκράτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ἐν Γέθ.

verses.translation: Have mercy upon me, O God; for man has trodden me down; all the day long he warring has afflicted me.

translations.ron: Călcatu-m-au vrăjmaşii mei toată ziua, că mulţi sunt cei ce se luptă cu mine, din înălţime.
translations.grk: Ἐλεήσον με ὁ Θεὸς, ὅτι κατεπάτησέ με ἄνθρωπος, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν πολεμῶν ἔθλιψέ με.

verses.translation: Mine enemies have trodden me down all the day from the dawning of the day; for there are many warring against me.

translations.ron: Ziua când mă voi teme, voi nădăjdui în Tine.
translations.grk: Κατεπάτησάν με οἱ ἐχθροί μου ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἀπὸ ὕψους ἡμέρας, ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ πολεμοῦντές με.

verses.translation: They shall be afraid, but I will trust in thee.

translations.ron: În Dumnezeu voi lăuda toate cuvintele mele toată ziua; în Dumnezeu am nădăjduit, nu mă voi teme: Ce-mi va face mie omul?
translations.grk: Φοβηθήσονται, ἐγὼ δὲ ἐλπιῶ ἐπὶ σοί.

verses.translation: In God I will praise my words; all the day have I hoped in God; I will not fear what flesh shall do to me.

translations.ron: Toată ziua cuvintele mele au urât, împotriva mea toate gândurile lor sunt spre rău.
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ Θεῷ ἐπαινέσω τοὺς λόγους μου, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐν τῷ Θεῷ ἤλπισα, οὐ φοβηθήσομαι τί ποιήσει μοι σάρξ.

verses.translation: All the day long they have abominated my words; all their devices are against me for evil.

translations.ron: Locui-vor lângă mine şi se vor ascunde; ei vor păzi călcâiul meu, ca şi cum ar căuta sufletul meu.
translations.grk: Ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν τοὺς λόγους μου ἐβδελύσσοντο, κατʼ ἐμοῦ πάντες οἱ διαλογισμοὶ αὐτῶν εἰς κακόν.

verses.translation: They will dwell near and hide themselves; they will watch my steps, accordingly as I have waited patiently in my soul.

translations.ron: Pentru nimic nu-i vei mântui pe ei; în mânie popoare vei sfărâma, Dumnezeule.
translations.grk: Παροικήσουσι καὶ κατακρύψουσιν αὐτοὶ, τὴν πτέρναν μου φυλάξουσι· καθάπερ ὑπέμεινα τῇ ψυχῇ μου.

verses.translation: Thou wilt on no account save them; thou wilt bring down the people in wrath.

translations.ron: Viaţa mea am spus-o ţie; pune lacrimile mele înaintea Ta, după făgăduinţa Ta.
translations.grk: Ὑπὲρ τοῦ μηθενὸς σώσεις αὐτοὺς ἐν ὀργῇ λαοὺς κατάξεις· ὁ Θεὸς

verses.translation: O God, I have declared my life to thee; thou hast set my tears before thee, even according to thy promise.

translations.ron: Întoarce-se-vor vrăjmaşii mei înapoi, în orice zi Te voi chema. Iată, am cunoscut că Dumnezeul meu eşti Tu.
translations.grk: τὴν ζωήν μου ἐξήγγειλά σοι, ἔθου τὰ δάκρυά μου ἐνώπιόν σου, ὡς καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐπαγγελίᾳ σου.

verses.translation: Mine enemies shall be turned back, in the day wherein I shall call upon thee; behold, I know that thou art my God.

translations.ron: În Dumnezeu voi lăuda graiul, în Dumnezeu voi lăuda cuvântul;
translations.grk: Ἐπιστρέψουσιν οἱ ἐχθροί μου εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω, ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπικαλέσωμαί σε· ἰδοὺ ἔγνων ὅτι Θεός μου εἶ σύ.

verses.translation: In God will I praise his word; in the Lord will I praise his saying.

translations.ron: În Dumnezeu am nădăjduit, nu mă voi teme: Ce-mi va face mie omul?
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ τῷ Θεῷ αἰνέσω ῥῆμα, ἐπὶ τῷ Κυρίῳ αἰνέσω λόγον.

verses.translation: I have hoped in God; I will not be afraid of what man shall do to me.

translations.ron: În mine sunt, Dumnezeule, făgăduinţele pe care le voi aduce laudei Tale,
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ τῷ Θεῷ ἤλπισα, οὐ φοβηθήσομαι τί ποιήσει μοι ἄνθρωπος.

verses.translation: The vows of thy praise, O God, which I will pay, are upon me.

translations.ron: Că ai izbăvit sufletul meu de la moarte, picioarele mele de alunecare, ca bine să plac înaintea lui Dumnezeu, în lumina celor vii.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἐμοὶ ὁ Θεὸς αἱ εὐχαὶ, ἃς ἀποδώσω αἰνέσεώς σου.

verses.translation: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, and my feet from sliding, that I should be well-pleasing before God in the land of the living.

translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐῤῥύσω τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐκ θανάτου, καὶ τοὺς πόδας μου ἐξ ὀλισθήματος, τοῦ εὐαρεστῆσαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν φωτὶ ζώντων.
